page: Amazon Web Services r6i.32xlarge is an enterprise-scale, memory-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. It features Intel Xeon 8375C processors running on the x86_64 architecture at 3.5 GHz. The instance delivers 128 dedicated vCPUs derived from 64 physical cores with two threads per core. System memory totals 1024.0 GB of DDR4 RAM operating at 3 GHz, yielding an allocation ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The processor topology includes a 48 KB L1 data cache, 1 MB L2 cache, and a 54 MB L3 cache, backed by instruction set extensions including AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, VAES, and SHA-NI.

Network connectivity is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 50 Gbps, accommodating high-throughput inter-node traffic. The instance includes no local storage, requiring that persistent data storage and operating volumes be provisioned via remote block storage. It also contains no discrete GPUs, prioritizing CPU execution and massive system memory over hardware accelerator pipelines.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong parallel compute and memory throughput. The system places in the top tier for PassMark overall CPU score, CPU extended instructions, and cryptographic operations, while stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core tests place in the top 25 percent. In-memory data throughput is highlighted by 334.71 GB/s uncached large-block reads and 107.75 million Redis SET operations per second. Conversely, single-core metrics fall within the middle 50 percent category across Geekbench single-core, stress-ng single-core, and data compression tests. The qualitative cost efficiency reflects a high-density compute and memory footprint that minimizes physical infrastructure overhead, balanced against the operational requirement to architect external storage.

The r6i.32xlarge is targeted at memory-intensive enterprise workloads, including large-scale in-memory databases, distributed caching layers such as Redis or Memcached, high-throughput static web serving, real-time analytics, and data pipeline processing.
description: Amazon Web Services r6i.32xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud instance powered by the AWS Nitro hypervisor and 3.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8375C processors. Configured with 128 vCPUs across 64 physical cores, it delivers 1024 GB of DDR4 memory and a 50 Gbps baseline network throughput. The instance includes hardware support for AVX-512 and cryptographic extensions such as VAES and SHA-NI. It contains no bundled local storage or GPUs, relying on remote block storage for persistence. Benchmark results show top-tier multi-threaded processing, top 10% CPU encryption marks, and exceptional memory throughput exceeding 334 GB/s uncached reads and 107 million Redis operations per second, though single-core performance remains average. The r6i.32xlarge represents a cost-effective hardware consolidation profile for memory-bound workloads, making it well suited for large in-memory databases, distributed memory caching, high-throughput web serving, and memory-intensive enterprise data processing.
